description: Outside orchestration, finish the work started with laviya_start_task_work: Laviya records the measured time as AI effort, moves the task to Ready for deploy (or targetStatus) and adds the completion comment. Safe to retry for the same sessionID: steps already done are not repeated.

comment.description: Plain-text completion note added as a task comment.

sessionID.description: sessionID returned by laviya_start_task_work; the call completes or resumes exactly that session.

targetStatus.description: Status name, case/space insensitive. Default: the project's Ready for deploy status.

workEndedAt.description: ISO 8601 time the work actually ended. Pass it only when completing late; the server keeps it between the start and now.

name: laviya_complete_task_work
title: Complete Task Work
